d: Industry: Hospitality, Hotels, Resorts, Tourism & Leisure

Our client in Saudi Arabia is seeking an experienced and creative Hotel Marketing Manager to lead marketing initiatives, strengthen brand positioning and increase hotel visibility and revenue. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing marketing strategies to promote hotel services, accommodation packages, dining facilities, events and hospitality experiences.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in hospitality marketing, digital campaigns, brand management and promotional activities, with a good understanding of the Saudi Arabian tourism market and customer expectations.
Develop and implement comprehensive hotel marketing strategies.
Plan promotional campaigns to increase hotel bookings and occupancy rates.
Manage hotel branding, positioning and digital marketing activities.
Oversee social media platforms, website content and online promotions.
Coordinate marketing campaigns for accommodation, dining, events and special packages.
Collaborate with sales, reservations and operations teams to support business objectives.
Develop partnerships with travel agencies, tourism companies and corporate clients.
Monitor customer feedback, market trends and competitor activities.
Manage marketing budgets and evaluate campaign effectiveness.
Prepare marketing reports and recommend strategies to improve brand awareness and revenue.
q: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Hospitality Management, Business Administration or a related field.
4–7 years of experience in hotel, resort or hospitality marketing.
Strong knowledge of hotel marketing strategies and tourism trends.
Experience managing digital campaigns and promotional activities.
Understanding of hotel booking channels and customer engagement.
Excellent communication, planning and leadership skills.
Knowledge of the Saudi Arabian hospitality and tourism market is highly preferred.
Must be currently residing in Saudi Arabia (KSA).
